Subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — next steps to register in Coupa

Hi Susan,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To get our procurement team set up to issue POs, could you complete the supplier registration in our Coupa portal? I attached a short checklist (PDF) that lists the minimum fields we need.

Quick asks to keep things moving:
- Please register using the company legal name and your company tax ID (EIN).
- Attach a W-9 (or local equivalent) to the registration.
- Confirm the primary billing contact (name + email + phone).

Link to register: https://supplier.coupa.redwood.example/enroll
Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Setup-Checklist.pdf

If you hit any portal errors, reply to this thread and we can escalate.

Looking forward to getting the first PO out — can you aim to finish registration by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Susan Peters <susan.peters@bluewaveanalytics.com>

Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 10:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — next steps to register in Coupa

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — I tried to register but the portal rejects our submission. The error reads: "Company already exists with different tax ID" (see attached screenshot). We do have an EIN: 12-3456789 and the legal name is BlueWave Analytics, Inc.

We haven't worked with Redwood before, so not sure why there's a conflicting record. Can you confirm if you already have an internal supplier record for us? Happy to send a W-9 if that helps.

Attaching: coupa-error-screenshot.png

Cheers,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 10:20:30 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding kickoff — BlueWave Coupa account registration issue

Laura / Ben — forwarding Susan's note. Vendor cannot create an account due to a presumed duplicate supplier in Coupa with a mismatched tax ID.

Can procurement ops confirm whether we have an existing supplier record for BlueWave Analytics (maybe legacy from a pilot)? If there's a duplicate, what is fastest path: merge in Coupa or create a manual supplier record so we can issue a PO while support works the ticket?

Vendor offered to provide W-9 immediately. Priority: get PO to vendor this week if possible.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 08:45:12 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Supplier onboarding kickoff — BlueWave Coupa account registration issue

Karthik, Ben — I looked into Coupa and there is an inactive supplier record under a slightly different legal name (BlueWave Analytics LLC) with a different EIN. This looks like a data entry issue from an old pilot in 2023.

I opened a support ticket with our Coupa admin contact; ticket ID: CW-11287 (link: https://coupa.redwood.example/support/tickets/CW-11287). I provided the vendor's EIN and asked Coupa to either merge the records or update the existing entry so Susan can claim the account. Estimated response: 24-48 hours.

Meanwhile, I can create a manual supplier record in our ERP (RWD-Proc) to enable a one-off PO if you approve. For that I need a signed W-9 and the vendor's billing address.

Proposed temporary flow:
- Ask vendor to attach W-9 here.
- Create manual supplier in ERP and route PO to vendor for initial SOW.
- Close loop once Coupa support resolves duplicate/merge.

If you want, Ben can coordinate the PO.

Laura
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Susan — thanks for flagging.

We can fast-track a manual PO while Coupa support fixes the duplicate. Could you please attach a completed W-9 (PDF) and confirm the following:
- Legal company name (as on W-9)
- Billing address (line 1, city, state, ZIP)
- Remit-to email for invoices

If you can get that to us today, I’ll prepare a temporary PO for the initial SOW. If you prefer, we can also wait for Coupa to merge the records, but that will likely take longer.

Thanks,
